sloka: अवेक्षमाणस्तां देवीं देवतामिव नन्दने ।ततो बहुविधां चिन्तां चिन्तयामास वानरः ।। ५.३०.२।।।।
transliteration: avekṣamāṇastāṁ devīṁ devatāmiva nandane ।tato bahuvidhāṁ cintāṁ cintayāmāsa vānaraḥ ।। 5.30.2।।।।

translations.english: The sight of Sita who seemed a deity in the Nandana garden of Indra, set a chain of reflections in his mind :
